incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-2026-4527 - P1 - private-controlplane-heartbeat-missing for customer acme-corp (region: eu-central-1)
incident-bot: Linking runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/private-controlplane-heartbeat
Alex Chen: saw this pop up, oncall handed off to me 2m ago, grabbing it
Priya Patel: acked in PagerDuty, pinging infra now - can you post what you're seeing Alex?
Alex Chen: initial: control plane vcenter reported no heartbeats from on-prem agent pool for acme-corp. metric: private.controlplane.heartbeat.missing spikes to 6m
Mike Rivera: any packet loss or BGP flaps reported to the VPC? checking onprem-agent logs now
Alex Chen: running quick checks:
```
# curl to controlplane health endpoint
curl -sS https://controlplane-eu.acme.internal/health | jq .
{"status":"degraded","last_heartbeat":"2026-03-14T19:57:10Z","missing_agents":5}
```
Jen O'Connor: thx. acme's infra team said they just rolled a network ACL change 10m ago via their infra-as-code pipeline
Sam B: confirmed I see a flood of TLS handshake resets from acme's IP space in our edge logs, likely network change broke controlplane connections
acme-support-bot: Customer acme-corp reported "we deployed firewall rule, some control-plane flips" via support ticket 9876
Priya Patel: tagging @oncall-rotation for visibility and starting mitigation plan: 1) validate controlplane health 2) attempt grace reconnects 3) fallback routing to backup controlplane in us-east-1 if unresolved in 15m
Alex Chen: trying reconnect to agent via management plane: `ssh -i /keys/acme onprem-agent-03 'sudo systemctl status redwood-agent'`
```
onprem-agent-03: Active: failed (Result: exit-code)
Last log: Network unreachable during TLS handshake
```
Mike Rivera: can we temporarily open a specific port for acme's CIDR? Priya, do we have approval for emergency config change in their VPC?
Priya Patel: customer responded in ticket: "we can rollback the ACL change in 5-10m" — asking them to revert. Meanwhile I'm preparing a controlplane side retry increase.
Alex Chen: bumping agent reconnect window and increasing controlplane accept retries. applying patch to staging first:
```
# patch applied
PATCH: controlplane.reconnect.max_attempts=12 -> 24
```
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-2026-4527 acknowledged by Priya Patel
Jen O'Connor: starting a canary rollback request to acme infra: "please revert acl rule id acl-998 for 10m to confirm"
acme-support-bot: Customer confirmed rollback started at 19:59:40Z
Alex Chen: after rollback we see agent heartbeats returning:
```
metric: private.controlplane.heartbeat.present spikes from 0 -> 5 within 45s
logs: TLS handshake success with onprem-agent-03
```
Sam B: monitoring for flapping; setting 10m cooldown before fully closing pager
Priya Patel: informing customer success and account lead: posting summary to #customer-success-acme
Mike Rivera: leaving a note for postmortem: need better preflight checks for ACL changes and an automated pre-rollback probe that can ask customer infra to revert when handshake error patterns detected
Alex Chen: handing off to Priya for follow-up and postmortem. I'm marking incident as mitigated but keeping SEV open until postmortem scheduled
Priya Patel: taking postmortem ownership; will run RCA and include timeline + recommended automated rollback play. If anyone has logs to add drop them here. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-2026-4527 resolved by Priya Patel at 20:08:10Z (duration ~10m34s)
